repos_data.description: A lightweight, Zsh-native vault for command execution with GPG encryption, interactive templates, and fzf integration.
command line interactive directory navigator with history (bash / ksh / zsh)
🎁 Plugin for zsh/bash that can switch between vagrant boxes, and can control them from outside of the vagrant directories.

Fig/Kiro-CLI-style command completion for Zsh   via a native macOS floating panel — matches   git/docker/kubectl/npm/aws and 40+ other CLIs   against hand-picked static tables (no daemon, no   network, no AI).
